# WoW Train (glosx.app)

> Free train trip planner for Europe, Japan and China. Describe a trip in plain language and get a rail itinerary with routes, journey times, operators and booking links. 359 route guides (130 in Europe, 196 in Japan, 33 in China) in English, Spanish, French, Italian and Japanese, plus open-data timetable pages built from official rail operator data. No account, no signup. Independent project by GLOSX, not affiliated with any rail operator.

WoW Train is a website, not a mobile app. Bookings are completed on partner platforms (Omio for Europe, Klook for Japan and China); WoW Train never processes payments and earns an affiliate commission at no extra cost to the traveller. Prices shown on the site are indicative; the final fare is the one on the partner site for the chosen date.

## Planner and route guides

- [AI trip planner](https://glosx.app/): describe a trip ("Zurich to Milan", "Tokyo to Kyoto", "Beijing to Shanghai") and get each leg with journey time and a booking link; Europe, Japan and China modes
- [All route guides](https://glosx.app/rutas/): index of the 359 route guides, Japan grouped by region, plus China's high-speed routes (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Hong Kong, Chengdu, Xi'an); each guide has journey time, stations and FAQ
- [Trains from London](https://glosx.app/trains-from-london/) and [trains from Paris](https://glosx.app/trains-from-paris/): hub pages with every direct route from those cities
- [Trains from the UK to Europe](https://glosx.app/trains-from-uk-to-europe/), [France to Spain](https://glosx.app/trains-from-france-to-spain/), [France to Italy](https://glosx.app/trains-from-france-to-italy/), [Germany to Italy](https://glosx.app/trains-from-germany-to-italy/): cross-border guides

## Open-data timetables (first train, last train, trains per day, fastest journey)

Calculated by glosx.app from official open GTFS/timetable data; each page states its source, method and a CSV download. The combined dataset (Switzerland, Austria, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Spain) is published on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23827431

- [Trains in Switzerland](https://glosx.app/swiss-trains/): 125 connections from opentransportdata.swiss (SBB); WoW Train is listed as a showcase on opentransportdata.swiss
- [Trains in Austria](https://glosx.app/austria-trains/): 368 connections from ÖBB open data
- [Trains in Spain](https://glosx.app/horarios-trenes-espana/): from Renfe open data
- [Trains in Norway](https://glosx.app/norway-trains/): from Entur open data
- [Trains in Sweden](https://glosx.app/sweden-trains/): from Trafiklab open data
- [Trains in Finland](https://glosx.app/finland-trains/): from Digitraffic open data
- [How late is the last train in Europe?](https://glosx.app/last-train-europe/): study of last departures across European routes

## Guides

- [Blog](https://glosx.app/blog.html): European and Japanese train travel guides (scenic routes, night trains, rail passes vs point-to-point tickets, limited express trains in Japan)
- [Scenic trains](https://glosx.app/blog-scenic-train-routes-europe.html): the most scenic rail routes in Europe

## Languages

English (default), Spanish (/es/), French (/fr/), Italian (/it/) and Japanese (/ja/). Every route guide exists in all five languages, e.g. https://glosx.app/rutas/tokyo-kyoto/ja/.
